class_id: a write the walk can never make leaves the plan row PENDING and claimed first on every wake, with no state that says so
feature: the pull-model field-plan walk (claimNextDueField + field-plan-walk.ts): any table and field whose fetcher answers SUPPLIED but whose write the consolidated writer refuses for a structural reason (row not keyable, table not on the consolidated write path, write flag off)
symptom: the dropped-write branch treats every dropped write as transient: state stays PENDING, attempts and last_attempt_at are untouched, next_due_at stays in the past. A due PENDING row is the claim query's highest priority (pri 0), so every walk takes it first, asks the source again, gets the same answer, drops the same write and puts it back. When the drop is structural (same cause, same outcome, OD-78) this repeats on every wake forever: the value never lands, the row never reaches a state that names the cause, attempts stays 0, and every plan-row count reads it as fresh work. pull_plan_stuck_reclaim does not see it because it reads only NOT_AVAILABLE_YET and CHECK_FAILED; the wake log shows it only as a warn line per row per wake.
